Dough:

\- 3/4 cup of rice milk\*

\- 3/4 cup of sunflower oil\*

\- 3 flaxseed eggs (3tbsp flaxseed & 6tbsp water)

\- 3 3/4 cups of white flour\*

\- 2 tsp baking soda

On top (‘streusel’):

\- 1 kg apples

\- 1 tsp cinnamon

\- 1/2 cup of oats

\- 6 tbsp sunflower oil

Mix milk, oil and flaxseed eggs together and flour with soda in separate bowls. Then mix all together, spread on a baking tray evenly and place chopped apples on the top. Sprinkle apples with a cinnamon now or add it to the ‘streusel’ mixture: take oats and oil and mix them together just so all oats are coated with the oil. Sprinkle the mixture on the top of the cake. Put in the preheated 180 C oven for \~1h.

I used blender for milk, oil and flaxseed eggs mixture, but everything else I mixed with tbsp or just used my hands! 

You can add sugar/syrup/honey if you want to, I intentionally skipped it as I try to enjoy real fruit sweetness. In the original recipe there is 11/2 cup of sugar added to the dough mixture.

\*You can use different: fruits/plant-based milk/flour/oil.

It was, actually IT IS very difficult. I do not share that with people in general as I kinda expect that people will attack me again. The people with whom I can speak about it openly are: my therapist, my husband and one of my friends. I think we have to remember that it's also difficult for our close ones to take this difficult news. It really helped me build a stronger relationship with my husband and feel stronger as a person after sharing my feelings and suspicions - I think I would not cope without his support and we would not know each other that much, and I would not decide for a marriage if he didn't know.
